title: Polli gets better at finding things
summary:
Polli learned sharper repository and code searches while dashboard loading, agent tool errors, and streaming usage got more predictable.

Polli gained repository-scoped issue and PR search with filters and pagination, plus code queries that locate exact symbols and trace callers, callees, and impact. Web research now preserves citations and reports extraction failures more clearly. PR reviews, request handling, conversation-retention controls, and subscription cleanup also improved.

Billing and weekly earnings no longer block other dashboard pages from loading. The Pollen page keeps wallet balances visible while earnings load or are unavailable. App-submission pre-review comments now mention submitters so requests for information are easier to spot.

Managed agents now report selected MCP servers that fail to start or list tools instead of quietly running without them. Tool-call errors have structured details, and provisional token counts no longer fail an otherwise successful stream. A Quest contribution added local MCP device sign-in, but a later PR removed that stdio server and its sign-in tools; the hosted HTTP MCP server remains.

highlights.title: Search repositories with Polli
highlights.text: Ask Polli to find issues and PRs within a repository, with filters for author, state, and base branch and paginated results.

highlights.title: Trace code with Polli
highlights.text: Polli can locate exact code symbols and trace callers, callees, and impact. Ambiguous matches are flagged rather than guessed.

highlights.title: More control over Polli
highlights.text: Polli adds conversation-retention controls and an `unsubscribe all` option for subscriptions.
